fact: Health CS Aden Duale said the national digital health system, which the Social Health Insurance Act requires to run member registration, pre-authorisation and claims through a secure and interoperable digital platform, is being implemented under a government contract with the Safaricom Consortium.

Legal Notice 77 of 2025, gazetted and in force 11 April 2025, sets up an enterprise service bus routing messages between certified digital health solutions, and requires health data controllers already using digital health solutions to be onboarded within six months of publication; it states the requirement, not that the onboarding had been done.
The Cabinet Secretary said regulatory bodies like KMPDC have been fully integrated with the health information system, and Afya Yangu enables patient data portability across facilities.

Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said Kenya's Health Information Exchange is operational across all Social Health Authority-contracted facilities, enabling real-time data sharing among hospitals, county governments and the national health system.

Health Cabinet Secretary Aden Duale said Kenya's Health Information Exchange is operational nationally across all SHA-contracted public, private and faith-based facilities, sharing data with county governments and the national health system.
The Ministry of Health says the Health Information Exchange was fully deployed as of December 2024, sharing patient records across health facilities.
The Ministry of Health says the national Health Information Exchange, including Client, Health Care Provider and Health Facility Registries, was fully deployed as of December 2024.
